ai4s.myKeys.title: My Keys
ai4s.myKeys.description: All keys under your name (name / status / tier / created at). Keys are issued via the approval flow; the plaintext is delivered by private message only once at issuance and is never shown here.
ai4s.myKeys.columns.name: Name
ai4s.myKeys.empty: No keys under your name yet. Use the button below to apply — once approved, the bot delivers the key plaintext via private message.
ai4s.myKeys.loadError: Failed to load. Please retry later; contact an administrator if it persists.
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.newDesc: Key creation goes through a Feishu approval; on approval the key is created automatically and delivered by private message.
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.newStep1: Open Feishu → Workbench → "Approvals" → start the approval named "ai4s API Key 申请".
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.newStep2: Fill in the purpose and pick an approver, then submit. New keys start on the trial tier.
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.newStep3: Once approved, the Feishu bot sends you the key plaintext in a private message (shown only once — save it immediately).
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.upgradeDesc: Quota upgrades go through a Feishu approval and apply to all of your enabled keys.
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.upStep1: Open Feishu → Workbench → "Approvals" → start the approval named "ai4s 额度提额申请".
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.upStep2: Set the target tier to 标准档 (standard) or 高档 (premium), pick an approver and submit.
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.upStep3: Once approved it takes effect automatically on all your enabled keys, with a receipt posted in the group.
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.localAccountHint: This account is not bound to a Feishu identity (local account) and cannot use the Feishu approval identity chain — please contact an administrator directly for key creation or upgrades.
